name: How long does it take to fix a slab leak?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to fix a slab leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to fix a slab leak varies significantly based on the complexity of the leak and the chosen repair method. A straightforward repair involving a small excavation might take a few hours to a full day. However, if the leak is difficult to locate, requires extensive re-piping, or involves significant concrete work, the process could extend over several days. Factors like drying times for concrete or new materials also contribute to the overall timeline. Your plumber can provide a more accurate estimate once the leak is assessed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; simple fixes can take hours, while complex re-piping or excavation might require several days. It depends on the specific leak.
